stage.name: Into the Groove
stage.description:
In addition to skills and tactics, momentum is also a key factor for a championship team. Keep winning to maintain morale!
<Convection Storm> Lightning strikes the football, dealing damage to nearby units and stunning them.
<Mercy Rule> First team to get a 5-goal lead wins.

javelineer.name: Javelineer
javelineer.flavourText: Soldier played by a Minoan citizen. Even ordinary soldiers have a chance to become heroes. The most important thing is to have the courage and resilience to pick up the sword when the javelin is broken.
abilities: Becomes melee if ranged attack misses

ocean_stonecutter.name: Ocean Stonecutter
ocean_stonecutter.flavourText: Sea Terror with a hard shell, protecting the swarm from enemies.
abilities: When your units enter its attack range for the first time, temporarily stops moving and gains increased DEF.

clockwork_patroller.name: Clockwork Patroller
clockwork_patroller.flavourText: Patrol machine developed for the local environment. Moves faster if it is wound up a few times before battle. Low firepower.
abilities: Movement speed is reduced in Emergency Heater range.

raging_man_eater.name: Raging Man Eater
raging_man_eater.flavourText: A biological weapon bred in a lab. Though a plant, it boasts astonishing bite force and digestive capabilities. What's even more terrifying is that they've started to appear in the wild.
abilities: Devours a surrounding unit but requires an extended period to digest on the spot before devouring again.

stress_relief_helper.name: Stress-Relief Helper
stress_relief_helper.flavourText: Punching robot used for stress relief by gang members. It would very much like to be on the punching side for once. The gang members who use it do not know that their stress has simply been transferred from human to robot, and it will return the favor someday.
abilities: Bounces <'Certain Fates'>

catapult.name: 'Catapult'
catapult.flavourText: Expert grenadiers of the delegation, able to throw shells as heavy as a hundred kilos. The rest of the delegation knows better than to challenge them to a snowball fight.
abilities: Throws a massive snowball, dealing splash damage in a cross
Can only use melee attacks once snowball is thrown

field_shooter.name: Field Shooter
field_shooter.flavourText: This musbeast was recruited as shooter under the reasoning that if it can leap high, it can kick a ball very, very far away.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

icefield_arts_fighter.name: Icefield Arts Fighter
icefield_arts_fighter.flavourText: A special warrior born in a harsh environment. While they mainly use Arts in combat, their bodies are simply another one of their weapons. They are at their most dangerous when they fall in battle.
abilities: When defeated, deals Arts damage to all surrounding units and inflicts Cold
Loses HP when shifted

wooden_burdenbeast_of_ilion.name: Wooden Burdenbeast of Ilion
wooden_burdenbeast_of_ilion.flavourText: The wooden burdenbeast of Ilion, played by Minoan citizens. In the age of city states, Athenians captured the previously impregnable city of Ilion by hiding soldiers inside a wooden burdenbeast. The story is so well-known that a group of Minoans squeezing themselves into a vehicle is immediately understood as a recreation of the legend, and onlookers are invited to join in.
abilities: Cannot be blocked.
Carries up to 5 passengers
Movement Speed reduced for each additional passenger

pocket_sea_crawler.name: Pocket Sea Crawler
pocket_sea_crawler.flavourText: A Sea Terror imbued with impurities. The density of its body tissue surpasses that of some alloys. Victims stabbed by it will feel as if they have been set alight.
abilities: Whenever a certain percentage of HP is lost, immediately deal a large amount of Arts damage and Nervous Impairment to nearby units

imperial_artillery_core_targeteer.name: Imperial Artillery Core Targeteer
imperial_artillery_core_targeteer.flavourText: A heavily-armored, sturdily-built core drone operated by artillery technicians of the Ursus army. They presage the withering firepower of the Ursus Artillery. The Ursus Artillery is a fire team that has bunkered down into the city. Though packing less firepower than naval guns, their equipment still shreds through buildings and armor with ease.
abilities: Flying unit.

sleep_companion_beast.name: Sleep Companion Beast
sleep_companion_beast.flavourText: Large and strong companion beast in the neverwaking story, carrying sleepers to wherever they may sleep soundly, though it does not know the way well.
abilities: Attacks inflict Nervous Impairment.
Carries any sleeping enemies or stunned Operators when passing through them, and puts them down after a while; taking up extra Block for the duration
Does not deduct Life Points when entering the Objective without carrying any units

suiton_ninja.name: Suiton Ninja
suiton_ninja.flavourText: A ninja who can spin in place for a long time. He claims that there is water surrounding him; your vision is just too poor to see it. Never stops spinning unless tripped.
abilities: Deals Physical damage to surroundings while spinning, and stops spinning when shifted
Bounces <'Certain Fates'>

compressed_ball.name: Compressed Ball
compressed_ball.flavourText: A football made from compressed building materials to enrich the match experience. 'Heavy' doesn't begin to describe it. Do your foot a favor and don't bother kicking it.
abilities: A heavy football that is hard to move.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

deep_sea_slider_ball.name: Deep Sea Slider Ball
deep_sea_slider_ball.flavourText: A ball made in the image of a strange sea creature. Like its inspiration, it excretes a mucous slime, but it is unable to slide smoothly. Instead, it gets stuck in its own slime all the time.
abilities: Leaves behind sticky slime on the ground
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

handmade_catapult.name: Handmade Catapult
handmade_catapult.flavourText: Catapult handmade from cardboard by Minoan citizens, limiting its power. It has been loaded with too many rocks, making bringing it to its destination an exhausting task and hampering its accuracy as the operator's hand is usually shaking from fatigue by the time it is actually used.
abilities: Attacks hit 3 times and deal physical splash damage
Aim deviates randomly when Immersed

infused_originium_ball.name: Infused Originium Ball
infused_originium_ball.flavourText: A football that imitates infused... Hey, why is it moving? Okay, it's actually a genuine infused Originium slug. Genuinely explosive, too!
abilities: Chance to explode when kicked, stunning and damaging nearby units.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

perpetual_rebounder.name: Perpetual Rebounder
perpetual_rebounder.flavourText: A football inspired by an extremely unstable entity to enrich the match experience. It is as unpredictable as its inspiration, and has already been bouncing all over the field for half an hour... Somebody stop it, please!
abilities: A very bouncy football.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

retching_broodmother.name: Retching Broodmother
retching_broodmother.flavourText: Sea Terror mothers that throw fake offspring at oncoming threats, allowing the true offspring to flee.
abilities: Can only attack ground targets
Summons 1 <Baleful Broodling> near the target when dealing damage

will_of_the_north_ball.name: Will of the North Ball
will_of_the_north_ball.flavourText: A ball made in the image of the indomitable will of the north. Like its inspiration, its mere presence summons snow and ice. Anyone up for a game of ice hockey?
abilities: Leaves behind slippery ice on the ground
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

icefield_arts_guard.name: Icefield Arts Guard
icefield_arts_guard.flavourText: A special warrior born in a harsh environment. As they gain insight into their Arts, they become more skilled at utilizing every last bit of their power. They are extremely dangerous when they fall in battle.
abilities: When defeated, deals Arts damage to all surrounding units and inflicts Cold
Loses HP when shifted

raging_direswine.name: Raging Direswine
raging_direswine.flavourText: A variety of Direswine extremely easy to anger, they dominate areas near water sources with great swagger. If one is enraged, it will indiscriminately rampage about with a madness sufficient to lay anything in the vicinity low.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
Gradually accelerates when charging, dealing damage based on Movement Speed to any target it passes through or is blocked by
